steps.js: const i=document.querySelector("input[placeholder*='Zip']"); const f=i.closest('aside,[role=dialog],[class*=flyout],[class*=drawer]')||document; f.querySelector('input[type=radio]').click(); await new Promise(x=>setTimeout(x,800)); Array.from(f.querySelectorAll('button')).find(b=>/continue shopping/i.test(b.innerText)).click(); return 'ok'
